This event brings together researchers from diverse disciplines and provides a platform for companies and other stakeholders interested in health-related topics. The event aims to foster collaboration and support the formation of consortia for Horizon Europe or other funding proposals, and is organised by the TRUEnet (Turku Region Universities EU Network) and Health Campus Turku.
